title.zh: 将东内格罗斯省 Siaton市镇 Siaton 小学的名称变更为Felipe Tayko 纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Name of Siaton Elementary School in the Municipality of Siaton, Province of Negros Oriental, to Felipe Tayko Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of Siaton Elementary School in the Municipality of Siaton, Province of Negros Oriental, to Felipe Tayko Memorial Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Siaton tại Đô thị Siaton, Tỉnh Negros Oriental thành Trường Tiểu học Tưởng niệm Felipe Tayko
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Siaton ในเทศบาล Siaton จังหวัด Negros Oriental เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ Felipe Tayko
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Siaton di Kotamadya Siaton, Provinsi Negros Oriental menjadi Sekolah Dasar Memorial Felipe Tayko
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Siaton di Perbandaran Siaton, Wilayah Negros Oriental kepada Sekolah Rendah Memorial Felipe Tayko

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1548_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In recognition of the valuable services rendered by the late Felipe Tayko to the Municipality of Siaton, Province of Negros Oriental, the name of Siaton Elementary School is hereby changed to Felipe Tayko Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
